intro.summary: Northwest inner-city community around Kensington Road and 10 Street NW, beside Riley Park and the Bow River, with houses, infills and condos.
intro.body: Hillhurst takes in much of the Kensington shopping district, with Riley Park, the Bow River pathways and the Sunnyside CTrain station close by. Its blocks mix early 1900s houses with newer infills, rowhouses and condo buildings. Single-family infill continues on its quieter residential streets.
